full_judgment:
Md. Rezaul Haque, J: On an application under section 561-A of the Code of Criminal Procedure rule was issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the impugned proceedings of Metro. Special Case No. 36 of 2005 arising out of G.R. No. 125 of 2000 corresponding to Kotwali police station Case No. 78 dated 26.10.2000 under section 406/409/467/468/471/109 of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 now pending in the Court of Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge, 5th Court, Dhaka should not be quashed. 

 2. Facts of the case, in short, are that on 26.10.2000 an Inspector of the Bureau of Anti Corruption, being informant lodged an ejahar with the Kotwali police station, Dhaka Metropolitan police, stating inter-alia, that the ejahar named accused persons in collusion with each other misappropriated Tk. 40,86,856/80 supposed to be paid as compensation money for acquision of land measuring 1.56 acres appertaining to S.A. Plot No. 948 corresponding to R.S. Plot No. 1083 under Mouza Digun of police station Mirpur and thereby they have committed offence under sections 406, 409, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 109 of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947. 

 3. The background of the case is that the Bureau of Anti Corruption, Dhaka Zone, at the time of inquiry found in Nothi No. 216-2000 Dha.Oa. that a decision was taken by the Ministry of Land on 26.1.2000 to acquire the said land in the name of Bangladesh Water Development Board in Digun Mouza under the Mirpur police station and accordingly, the said land was acquired in LA Case No. 8/44 of 2000 by the office of the Deputy Commissioner, Dhaka. It has been found that 0.56 acre of land out of 1.56 acre in Digun Mouza S.A Plot No. 948 of R.S. record corresponding to Plot No. 1083, originally owned by Shuresh Chandra Gope and rest 1.30 acre was owned by Noresh Chandra Gope, and Romesh Chandra Gope and they were in India. The Government of Bangladesh became the owner of 1.30 acres of land as the same became enemy property and vested on the government as non-resident property. But accused Ms. Rokeya Begum showing herself as the owner of 1.56 acres of land by making false deed being deed No. 9116 dated 16.4.1974 submitted the same with an application before the Assistant Commissioner of land, Tejgaon Circle, for mutating her name in her favour and by using the said false deed it was recorded in her name through Mutation Case No. 4742/99-2000. Accused No.2 Md. Lutfur Rahman Chowdhury being Tohshilder of Mirpur Office, Dhaka, knowing well that the land was vested and non-resident property, recommended mutation in favour of Most.Rokeya Begum, suppressing the fact that the property in question was vested and non resident property.After mutation the accused No.1 Most. Rokeya Begum showing the record in her name applied for compensation to the Land Acquision Officer, Dhaka, and on the basis of her application the accuseds No. 3-7 in collusion with her, by taking illegal gratification issued cheque No. 019377 dated 7.5.2000 amounting to Tk. 40,86,656.80 as compensation infavour of the accused No.1 Ms. Rokeya Begum. In this circumstance, all the FIR named accused persons in collusion with each other have misappropriated the said amount and thereby committed offence punishable under section 406,409,420,467,468,471 and 109 of the Penal Code read with section 5(2) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 and on the basis of such allegation an FIR being Kotwali P.S. Case No. 78 dated 26.10.2000 was lodged against 7 persons named in the Ejahar. 

 4. Thereafter the case was investigated by the same Inspector of the Anti Corruption Bureau, who lodged FIR and having found prima-facie case he submitted charge sheet against the 7 accused persons amongst whom the petitioner is in serial No. 2 and recommended for discharging the Tahsilder, Additional Land Acquisition Officer and former land acquisition officer. 

 5. Thereafter the case record was transmitted to the Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge, 5th Court, Dhaka for trial and date was fixed for framing charge against the accused persons and the accused persons being petitioners filed an application under section 265C of the Code of Criminal Procedure for discharging them. After hearing the parties the learned Judge was pleased to reject the application filed under section 265C of the Code of Criminal Procedure and framed charge against them. 

 6. Thereafter, the present accused petitioner filed this miscellaneous case under section 561A of the Code of Criminal Procedure and obtained the instant rule. 

 10. It is evident that in the FIR, Annexure-A, the name of this petitioner was not there. But subsequently at the time of investigation of this case the investigating officer recommended his name as an accused of this case without mentioning any specific overtact against this petitioner. In the charge sheet it is stated, 

 11. But from the above mentioned observation made by the investigation officer there is nothing specific as to that what type of work has been done or what role has been played or what offence has been committed by this petitioner? The investigation officer just has proposed the name of the petitioner along with some other persons for taking cognizance against them. In the charge sheet the investigating officer has opined that this petitioner along with other accused persons by taking gratification has mutated the name of accused Mosammat Rokeya Begum in connection with mutation case No. 4742 of 1999-2000 without considering that the petitioner was mere a mutation assistant in the office of the Assistant Commissioner, Working as Assistant to the Tahshilder who is the main person authorized for mutation. It is further evident that the investigation officer also recommended for discharging the Tahsilder along with two others. It is well known that in a mutation case the Tahsilder is the person who plays the key role and he is the key person who after inquiry gives report on the basis of which the mutation proceeding continues but the investigating officer without considering this aspect proposed for discharging him along with other two officials in the charge sheet. The learned Judge also without considering the same has accepted the charge sheet and also accepted the recommendations of the investigation officer and discharged the Tahsilder and other officials from the charge. It is further evident that the land acquisition officer was also an accused in this case but he filed another criminal Miscellaneous Case being Miscellaneous case No. 6355 of 2007 for quashing the proceeding against him and that rule has been made absolute by this Division. After scrutiny it is evident that one departmental proceeding was started against some of the accused persons but since there was no allegation against the petitioner nothing has come out in the report of the authority against the petitioner, and others were found guilty of the offence and department took action against them but the committee constituted by the departmental authority did not get any evidence against this petitioner so, no action was taken against him. It is evident from the record that the high powered three member committee recommended as under: 

 15. In the result, the rule is made absolute. The proceeding of Metro. Special Case No. 36 of 2005 arising out of Kotwali P.S. Case No. 78 dated 26.10.2000 corresponding to G.R. No. 125 of 2000 so far as it relates to the present petitioner is hereby quashed.
